modules.name: Raffle
modules.role: ERC-1167 clone implementation that escrows one prize NFT, sells transferable ERC-721 range tickets, requests and consumes VRF randomness, transitions the raffle lifecycle, allocates sale proceeds, and processes redemption or refunds.

modules.name: RaffleFactory
modules.role: Ownerless immutable factory that validates raffle parameters, deploys and initializes clones, registers them, and atomically escrows the sponsor's prize.

modules.name: IRaffle
modules.role: Defines the raffle lifecycle enum, initialization parameters, events, errors, state-changing API, views, and generated-getter surface.

modules.name: IRaffleFactory
modules.role: Defines raffle-creation parameters, factory events and errors, creation API, and registry/configuration getters.

modules.name: RaffleConstants
modules.role: Defines fixed entry price, percentage allocations, sale and callback windows, refund batch bound, and VRF parameters.

modules.name: VRFV2PlusWrapperConsumerBase
modules.role: Provides native-funded randomness requests and the wrapper-authenticated external callback that dispatches to Raffle.fulfillRandomWords.

modules.name: IVRFV2PlusWrapper
modules.role: Defines the trusted wrapper boundary for pricing, native-funded request creation, request IDs, and LINK metadata.

modules.name: VRFV2PlusClient
modules.role: Encodes the native-payment extra arguments used by requestDraw.

modules.name: OpenZeppelin ERC721
modules.role: Implements ticket ownership, balances, approvals, transfers, safe-receiver callbacks, minting, and burning beneath Raffle's _update override.

modules.name: ERC721Utils
modules.role: Performs contract-recipient callbacks after safe ticket mints and transfers.

modules.name: SafeERC20
modules.role: Performs quote-token transferFrom collection and transfer payouts with optional-return handling.

modules.name: ReentrancyGuard
modules.role: Supplies the shared storage-slot guard used by factory creation and raffle value/state-changing entrypoints.

modules.name: Clones
modules.role: Deploys fixed-target ERC-1167 raffle proxies from the factory.

modules.name: Math
modules.role: Provides full-precision floor mulDiv calculations for winner and protocol allocations.

entrypoints.name: initialize(RaffleInitParams calldata params)
entrypoints.reachableBy: Any caller can attempt it on a clone, but the accepted path requires the immutable canonical factory and uninitialized clone storage.

entrypoints.name: buyEntries(address recipient, uint128 entryCount)
entrypoints.reachableBy: Any quote-token payer can call while the raffle is Active and before endTime; the recipient may be a different EOA or contract.

entrypoints.name: requestDraw()
entrypoints.reachableBy: Any caller can fund the native VRF request after the sale ends and before the request deadline when entries exist.

entrypoints.name: enableRefunds()
entrypoints.reachableBy: The sponsor can close an empty Active raffle before endTime; otherwise any caller can invoke it once the applicable sale/request/callback deadline has arrived.

entrypoints.name: settleWinningTicket(uint256 ticketId)
entrypoints.reachableBy: Any caller can submit a ticket range after an NftWon or CashWon result; ownership is not required.

entrypoints.name: redeemWinningTicket(uint256 ticketId)
entrypoints.reachableBy: The current owner of the winning ticket can call after an NftWon or CashWon result, with settlement performed inline if needed.

entrypoints.name: refundTickets(uint256[] calldata ticketIds)
entrypoints.reachableBy: A current ticket owner can burn a bounded batch of its tickets while status is Refunding.

entrypoints.name: releaseSponsorProceeds()
entrypoints.reachableBy: Any caller can trigger release of the full allocated sponsor balance to the fixed sponsorRecipient.

entrypoints.name: releaseProtocolFees()
entrypoints.reachableBy: Any caller can trigger release of the full allocated protocol balance to the fixed protocolTreasury.

entrypoints.name: releaseSponsorPrize()
entrypoints.reachableBy: Any caller can trigger return of the configured prize to sponsorRecipient in CashWon or Refunding status.

entrypoints.name: onERC721Received(address operator, address from, uint256 tokenId, bytes calldata data)
entrypoints.reachableBy: Any contract can invoke the selector, but acceptance requires AwaitingPrize status and the configured prize-token caller, token ID, sponsor source, and factory operator.

candidates.name: createRaffle(CreateRaffleParams calldata params)
candidates.why: Coordinates untrusted configuration validation, clone deployment and initialization, registry mutation, prize-token callbacks, escrow verification, and atomic activation.

candidates.name: buyEntries(address recipient, uint128 entryCount)
candidates.why: Validates sale inputs, collects quote tokens, assigns contiguous global ranges, mutates accounting, mints the bearer claim, and may call an untrusted ticket recipient.

candidates.name: requestDraw()
candidates.why: Enforces the draw window, handles native value, moves the lifecycle to Drawing, coordinates an external wrapper request and in-flight callback state, persists the request ID, and refunds excess value.

candidates.name: rawFulfillRandomWords(uint256 _requestId, uint256[] memory _randomWords)
candidates.why: Is the externally reachable authorization boundary between the trusted wrapper and Raffle's internal resolution transition.

candidates.name: fulfillRandomWords(uint256 requestId, uint256[] memory randomWords)
candidates.why: Filters callback timing, request identity, word count, lifecycle and in-flight state, then selects the winning entry and terminal economic result.

candidates.name: _settleWinningTicket(uint256 ticketId)
candidates.why: Validates the winning range and performs the one-time, rounding-sensitive allocation of the full unsettled pot among winner, sponsor, and treasury liabilities.

candidates.name: redeemWinningTicket(uint256 ticketId)
candidates.why: Combines optional settlement, current-owner authorization, ticket burning, redemption flags, and either NFT delivery verification or quote-token payment.

candidates.name: enableRefunds()
candidates.why: Implements the sponsor/time/status-dependent refund transitions and converts the unsettled pot into aggregate refund liability.

candidates.name: refundTickets(uint256[] calldata ticketIds)
candidates.why: Validates a bounded untrusted batch, checks current ownership, reconstructs represented entries, burns claims, decrements aggregate liability, and transfers quote tokens.

candidates.name: initialize(RaffleInitParams calldata params)
candidates.why: Enforces one-time factory authorization, screens all configured destinations, writes clone-specific trust and economic parameters, and establishes AwaitingPrize state.

candidates.name: onERC721Received(address operator, address from, uint256 tokenId, bytes calldata data)
candidates.why: Is the prize-token callback boundary whose caller, operator, source, token ID, and lifecycle checks activate a clone.

candidates.name: _update(address to, uint256 ticketId, address auth)
candidates.why: Mediates every ticket mint, transfer, and burn, couples destination screening to inherited authorization, approval, balance, and ownership mutation.

candidates.name: _validateCreateParams(CreateRaffleParams calldata params)
candidates.why: Centralizes validation of sponsor-selected prize and recipient addresses, factory registry exclusions, ERC-165 responses, and the nonzero reserve.

candidates.name: constructor(address quoteToken_, address vrfWrapper_, address protocolTreasury_)
candidates.why: Establishes all deployment trust anchors, validates quote-token metadata and wrapper code, and creates the sole registered implementation lineage.

candidates.name: constructor(address quoteToken_, address vrfWrapper_)
candidates.why: Fixes factory, quote-token, wrapper and LINK immutables and establishes the locked implementation's initialized/refunding state.

candidates.name: _isProtocolDestination(address destination, address prizeToken_)
candidates.why: Provides shared destination classification for initialization, ticket ownership changes, and quote payouts using both fixed addresses and the factory registry.

candidates.name: releaseSponsorPrize()
candidates.why: Gates terminal prize return, consumes the one-time prize claim, calls the untrusted prize contract, and verifies resulting ownership.

candidates.name: _transferQuote(address to, uint256 amount)
candidates.why: Is the shared quote-payout boundary, combining destination classification with the trusted token's external transfer semantics.

candidates.name: releaseSponsorProceeds()
candidates.why: Consumes the complete sponsor liability before transferring it to the immutable sponsor recipient.

candidates.name: releaseProtocolFees()
candidates.why: Consumes the complete protocol liability before transferring it to the immutable treasury.

candidates.name: _requireWinningTicket(uint256 ticketId)
candidates.why: Connects the randomly selected global entry to one persistent inclusive ticket range and gates all terminal allocation.

candidates.name: transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId)
candidates.why: Is the externally reachable bearer-claim transfer path that performs owner/operator authorization and dispatches through Raffle._update.

candidates.name: safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data)
candidates.why: Adds an untrusted recipient callback after the authorized ticket state transition and Raffle destination screening.
